candidates.name: osteoma
support_spans: a painless mass on the right side of the frontal bone
well circumscribed, soft, nonmobile, and non-tender
candidates.why: The mass is described as painless and well-circumscribed, which is consistent with a benign bone tumor like osteoma.

candidates.name: fibrous dysplasia
support_spans: a large, circumscribed radiolucent lesion in the right frontal bone
cortical destruction of the inner and outer tables
candidates.why: The radiolucent lesion and cortical destruction are consistent with fibrous dysplasia, a condition that affects bone.

candidates.name: Paget's disease of bone
support_spans: lytic lesion of the frontal bone
cortical destruction of the inner and outer tables
candidates.why: The lytic lesion and cortical destruction are consistent with Paget's disease of bone, which is characterized by abnormal bone remodeling.

candidates.name: osteosarcoma
support_spans: a lobulated frontal-bone mass
showed avid enhancement on postcontrast sequences
candidates.why: The lobulated mass and avid enhancement are consistent with osteosarcoma, a malignant bone tumor.

candidates.name: osteoblastoma
support_spans: CT of the head demonstrated a lytic lesion of the frontal bone
soap-bubble appearance
candidates.why: The soap-bubble appearance on CT is consistent with osteoblastoma, a benign bone tumor.

candidates.name: giant cell tumor
support_spans: a large, circumscribed radiolucent lesion in the right frontal bone
showed avid enhancement on postcontrast sequences
candidates.why: The radiolucent lesion and avid enhancement are consistent with giant cell tumor, a benign but locally aggressive bone tumor.
